config.notes: ULethbridge programme pages are www.ulethbridge.ca/future-student/program/<subject> (undergraduate, one page per subject covering BA, BA&Sc, combined degrees) and /future-student/graduate-studies/<programme>. Both print a labelled block: Credentials available / Campus (Lethbridge, Calgary) / Intake (e.g. "Fall & Winter", "Fall", "Summer"). Term months from the university academic schedule (https://www.ulethbridge.ca/sites/ross/files/imported/academic-schedule/Academic-Schedule.pdf; https://www.ulethbridge.ca/ross/admissions/grad/deadlines): Fall = September, Winter = January. Summer is deliberately NOT mapped: the Summer term opens in May but Summer-intake graduate programmes (e.g. PhD in Education) start on campus in July, so a Summer intake gives no month. Pages carry NO fee and NO IELTS: international tuition is central (https://www.ulethbridge.ca/future-student/undergraduate-tuition-fees, 2026/27 CAD 24,662.20 per year full-time) and English is central (https://www.ulethbridge.ca/ross/admissions/elp and /ross/admissions/grad/elr: IELTS 6.5 overall, 6.0 each band). /ross/post-diploma/eligible/N pages are diploma-transfer tables, not programme pages; "(program suspended)" in their titles is read as not_admitting. Catalogue course codes are ALIS programme ids, not printed on pages. Most courses are bound to the wrong pages (old PDF planning guides, department, careers, news pages): rebinding undergraduate courses to /future-student/program/<subject> is the fix. Delivery (mode): the programme page sentence on delivery, e.g. "International students This program is online delivery format" (Master of Nursing, online) or "programs are delivered on the Lethbridge campus" (M.Sc.); pages without such a sentence give no delivery. International view (5 Oct 13:02 review): programme pages print one view (Intake, Campus and the international-students delivery sentence in the plain page); fee and IELTS are central only, so no page_view is needed. Courses were rebound by hand to /future-student/program/<subject> (undergraduate) and /future-student/graduate-studies/<credential>/<subject> (graduate). Title identity: course_title_strip takes the credential off the catalogue title and title_strip takes the bracketed credential off the page title ("Cultural, Social, and Political Thought (MA)"), so a subject of two or more words is confirmed; single-word subjects (Anthropology, Chemistry ...) cannot be confirmed by title (the worker needs two words) and stay "manual". Graduate programme pages also print a facts block: "Length of program ... Mode of delivery In person ... Campus Lethbridge Intake Summer, Fall and Winter"; mode reads "Mode of delivery" first, then the delivery sentence. Undergraduate subject pages print no delivery wording.
